messages:
tia: heads-up: saw a handful of SCIM provisioning failures for tenant-t42. Error: 'invalid_encryption: jwe_decrypt failed' in logs. suspecting idp started encrypting id_tokens payloads.

mohit: can you paste a stack line?

tia: `2026-04-12T09:11:01Z ERROR scim: jwe decrypt failed: unsupported alg RSA-OAEP-512` user=tenant-t42`. our JWE stack supports RSA-OAEP and RSA-OAEP-256 only.

rene: question: do we use KMS for any of this? if vendor changes alg we might need to update our kdf/config.

mohit: our KMS only stores keys for service signing. We don't act as a decryption KMS for customer idp JWEs. For JWE we rely on idp to use kid pointing to a shared key or use direct symmetric.

tia: vendor notes: they toggled 'stronger encryption' flag in their IdP, started sending RSA-OAEP-512. They claim it's standard in their platform.

rene: mitigation: we should reject with audit code `IDP_UNSUPPORTED_JWE` and surface a clear remediation to the customer (ask IdP to switch to RSA-OAEP or provide a compatible token format). Also add a telemetry counter.

sre-bot: INCIDENT CREATED #inc-2026-099-jwe-unsupported alg severity:P3 owners:@mohit runbook: identity/jwe-handling.md

mohit: I'll draft the audit UI change and a short support template. Follow-ups: add decision doc on which JWE algs we support and update onboarding checklist.

tia: thanks. attaching sample failing header to the incident doc. will coordinate with support to notify the tenant and vendor SRE.
